Volume
Hay movement slowed this past week as much of the state received heavy rainfall. Demand remained high. Recent rainfall and warm 
temperatures have many producers anticipating another cutting of alfalfa. According to the US Drought Monitor for the week of October 
8
th, 
in the High Plains, widespread heavy precipitation abetted robust improvement across eastern Colorado, central and western Kansas, and 
parts of southern Nebraska. Numerous locations reported 
3
 to locally over 
6
 inches of rain, which was sufficient to support 
2
-category 
improvements in portions of southeastern Colorado and the western half of Kansas. In Kansas, the categorical percent area of abnormally dry 
conditions (D
0
) decreased to 
18%
, Moderate drought (D
1
) decreased to 
20%
, severe drought (D
2
) decreased to 
10%
, and there was no 
extreme drought (D
3
) or exceptional drought (D
4
) recorded with 
51%
 of the state experiencing no drought. Prices below reflect the average 
price. There could be prices higher and lower prices than those published.
